_comment: NWPS sample points moved by hand, keyed by spot slug. apply_nwps_assignments writes nwps_node_lat/lng from here (and the distance from the spot) in place of the node in scripts/nwps_okx_assignments.json, so a re-bake from that file keeps the move. 'replaces' is the node the move was measured against: if the assignment ever names a different node (the spot was re-placed), apply_nwps_assignments stops rather than override a placement nobody measured. Each new node is a CG1 grid cell centre on the spot's own WFO grid. Evidence: sw1-raycast run 50 (mode face-seaward, commit 133cde0, 2026-10-27), artifact face-seaward-50, saved under docs/face_validation/run-50/ on claude/practical-dirac-bshfbr-face; each cell is the nearest NWPS cell at least 10 m deep (ETOPO 2022) within 30 deg of the spot's facing, read from the same 6 NOMADS cycles as the current point. The Hatteras three (rodanthe, salvo, s-turns) are from sw1-raycast run 58 (mode nwps-cells, commit e244d2a, 2026-10-29), artifact nwps-cells-58, saved under docs/face_validation/run-58/: there ETOPO puts the current points in 10 to 13 m, so depth alone would keep them; each new cell is the nearest within 30 deg of the facing that is at least 10 m deep at its centre AND whose NWPS Hs is at least 0.9 of the cell one column further seaward in every cycle read.

duck-pier.reason: The current point (1.14 km N, 7.4 m) read 0.76 of the FRF 8 m array, 25% of hours within 20%, r 0.38; the 15 m cell 2.07 km at 56 deg read 0.87, 98.6% within 20%, r 0.93 (72 h). Run 49 found the same over 66 h: 0.75, 18% within 20%, r 0.17 at the current point against 0.87, 98.5%, r 0.89 at the cell.
duck-pier.evidence: sw1-raycast run 50 (face-seaward, 133cde0), 72 h against FRF 8 m; run 49 (face-followup, 538be6d), 66 h

rodanthe.reason: The current point (10.3 m by ETOPO) is the beach column beside the stretch where MHX's grid has no island (Pamlico Sound water at -75.4744 from 35.559 to 35.607): NWPS read 0.18 of the pier there (0.17 to 0.18 in each of 4 cycles), 0.16 of the cell one column seaward, at an ocean-like 8.0 s. Against the pier since 2026-09-07 it read under 0.4 in 1189 of 1294 hours, and in all 630 hours with the pier at 1 m or more (median 0.11). The 16.9 m cell 2.46 km at 99 deg read 1.09 of the pier in every cycle and 0.98 of the cell beyond it.
